senses.gloss: f. (חפף I, v. חִיפָּא) border of a garment (limbus), a kind of front bosom in which things can be hidden.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:3">Sabb. X, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 92a">92ᵃ</cite>) <he>ובח׳ חלוקו</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, ed. <he>ובשפת</he>) in the bosom of his shirt.

<cite ref="Yoma 77b:11">Yoma 77ᵇ</cite> <he>ובלבד</he> … <he>מח׳ חלוקו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מתחת ח׳</he>) provided he takes not his hand out of the bosom of his shirt (to throw his cloak over his shoulder).
